say:1:1630323101:1.text: A test? Oh right, humans love those.
say:1:1630323101:1.source_cn: 考试？哦，人类是很爱考试。
say:1:1630323101:1.male: A test? Oh right, humans love those.
say:1:1630323101:1.female: A test? Oh right, humans love those.

say:2:1630323102:1.text: They say "Let me test you," but most of the time they don't even have the answers themselves!
say:2:1630323102:1.source_cn: 他们总是爱说：我来考考你。但其实他们自己什么都不知道。
say:2:1630323102:1.male: They say "Let me test you," but most of the time they don't even have the answers themselves!
say:2:1630323102:1.female: They say "Let me test you," but most of the time they don't even have the answers themselves!

say:3:1630323103:1.text: One human writes a bunch of weird stuff, then makes other humans memorize them. And that's called a test.
say:3:1630323103:1.source_cn: 一个人想出那么多东西，又叫别人背下来。他们管这个叫考试。
say:3:1630323103:1.male: One human writes a bunch of weird stuff, then makes other humans memorize them. And that's called a test.
say:3:1630323103:1.female: One human writes a bunch of weird stuff, then makes other humans memorize them. And that's called a test.

say:4:1630323104:1.text: So basically, they turn whatever's in their head into a guessing game?
say:4:1630323104:1.source_cn: 难道不都是他们自己的想法吗？
say:4:1630323104:1.male: So basically, they turn whatever's in their head into a guessing game?
say:4:1630323104:1.female: So basically, they turn whatever's in their head into a guessing game?

say:5:1630323105:1.text: I'd never ask someone to figure out what's going on inside my head. That's just rude.
say:5:1630323105:1.source_cn: 我就不会让别人猜我的脑子里在想什么。
say:5:1630323105:1.male: I'd never ask someone to figure out what's going on inside my head. That's just rude.
say:5:1630323105:1.female: I'd never ask someone to figure out what's going on inside my head. That's just rude.

choice_prompt:6:1630323105.text: I'd never ask someone to figure out what's going on inside my head. That's just rude.
choice_prompt:6:1630323105.source_cn: 我就不会让别人猜我的脑子里在想什么。
choice_prompt:6:1630323105.male: I'd never ask someone to figure out what's going on inside my head. That's just rude.
choice_prompt:6:1630323105.female: I'd never ask someone to figure out what's going on inside my head. That's just rude.

say:8:1630323107:1.text: But thanks to these noisy humans, I haven't had a decent sleep in ages! I can hear their racket even in my cave!
say:8:1630323107:1.source_cn: 这些人类打扰我睡觉了！我躲在洞里都能听到他们吵吵嚷嚷！
say:8:1630323107:1.male: But thanks to these noisy humans, I haven't had a decent sleep in ages! I can hear their racket even in my cave!
say:8:1630323107:1.female: But thanks to these noisy humans, I haven't had a decent sleep in ages! I can hear their racket even in my cave!

say:9:1630323108:1.text: Humans are a strange bunch. I'll never understand them.
say:9:1630323108:1.source_cn: 有时候人类真的很莫名其妙。
say:9:1630323108:1.male: Humans are a strange bunch. I'll never understand them.
say:9:1630323108:1.female: Humans are a strange bunch. I'll never understand them.
